neighbours.label: Superlative ' most' before an adjective (the most common, the most talented); quantifier 'most' (most people) and plain degree words stay quiet
fire: Of all the trees here, oaks are the most common.
It is arguably the most important book of the century.
She was the most gifted pupil in the class.
This is by far the most expensive hotel in town.
He is easily the most popular teacher at the school.
Paris is one of the most visited cities in the world.
That was the most boring film I have seen.
These are among the most dangerous roads in the country.
quiet: Of all the trees here, most are in the north.
Most books of the century are out of print.
Most pupils in the class were gifted.
This is by far a very expensive hotel in town.
He is easily a popular teacher at the school.
Paris is one of many visited cities in the world.
That was a boring film I have seen.
These are among the many dangerous roads in the country.

notes: Card: ' most' x22, ' more' x2, '-most' x2, 'ほど'. Logit effect of the + pole promotes ' greater', ' more', ' extremely'. Probe: the most common 0.74, most talented 0.48, most underrated 0.44; Most people 0.01, Most of 0.01, a very underrated 0.10. ' more' is a known overlap (0.27-0.61) and is left out of the near misses.
